quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Being speechless but smiling usually points to a very specific kind of news.
quests.explanation: Being left speechless with a smile at life-changing family news reflects overwhelming happiness.
quests.textToSpeak: Today I found out I'm going to be a grandfather for the first time. I couldn't say a word — I just smiled.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Months of work destroyed by a careless decision tends to bring an immediate, strong reaction.
quests.explanation: Losing months of work to someone else's careless action is a direct and common cause of anger.
quests.textToSpeak: You deleted the entire folder without checking with anyone first. Three months of work — gone!

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Asking for silence to concentrate on something unfamiliar reveals a particular state of mind.
quests.explanation: Asking for quiet to focus on a task you've barely done before is a clear sign of nervousness.
quests.textToSpeak: This is only my second time driving on a motorway. Please don't talk to me until we're off it.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: 'Felt like saying goodbye again' points to a feeling tied to someone no longer around.
quests.explanation: Seeing a loved one's belongings in a public place, and feeling like you're saying goodbye again, reflects sadness.
quests.textToSpeak: He left all his books to the school library. Walking past the shelf today felt like saying goodbye again.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A familiar-looking painting with no information attached tends to pull at a particular feeling.
quests.explanation: A painting that feels familiar but can't be identified naturally creates curiosity.
quests.textToSpeak: The old painting in the hallway has no label, no artist name, and no date. It seems oddly familiar somehow.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: An unexpected sellout, beating your own expectations, brings a particular rush of feeling.
quests.explanation: Selling out faster than you ever expected is exactly the kind of news that brings excitement.
quests.textToSpeak: We sold out every table for opening night! I never thought we'd fill the restaurant this fast.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Hearing information read aloud that you already have in front of you tends to produce one clear reaction.
quests.explanation: Sitting through information you already have, read aloud word for word, is a common cause of boredom.
quests.textToSpeak: The professor spent the entire lecture reading directly from slides we'd already been given online.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: 'Hard to believe' is doing a lot of work in this sentence. What feeling does it point to?
quests.explanation: Calling something 'hard to believe' in today's world is a natural way of expressing surprise.
quests.textToSpeak: He said he doesn't own a mobile phone — and he genuinely means it. In this day and age, that's hard to believe.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Words losing their meaning after hours of close reading is a physical, mental sign of something.
quests.explanation: Reaching the point where familiar words stop making sense is a classic sign of mental tiredness.
quests.textToSpeak: I've read this manuscript so many times tonight the words don't make sense to me anymore. I need to stop before I send it.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Think about what it's like to hear someone you love talk about losing their memory.
quests.explanation: Hearing someone you love admit they're forgetting names is a gentle but real cause of sadness.
quests.textToSpeak: He turned eighty today and said he wishes he could remember everyone's names. It was hard to hear.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A pattern repeating so often you've stopped counting tends to build a strong reaction.
quests.explanation: The same inconsiderate habit repeating four times in a month is a common trigger for anger.
quests.textToSpeak: My brother borrowed my bike without asking again. I've lost count of how many times now.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Over-preparing and still being unable to sleep before a big first day points to a particular feeling.
quests.explanation: Preparing carefully and still lying awake before a big first day is a familiar sign of nervousness.
quests.textToSpeak: First day of high school tomorrow. I've laid out my clothes, packed my bag, and I still can't sleep.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A small personal project finally paying off tends to bring a quiet, positive feeling.
quests.explanation: Watching something you've cared for slowly succeed brings a real, if quiet, happiness.
quests.textToSpeak: My tomatoes are finally red. Three months of careful watering, and this little garden is coming to life.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Pressing every button without understanding any of the labels leaves you feeling a certain way.
quests.explanation: Trying every option without understanding the instructions is a very ordinary kind of confusion.
quests.textToSpeak: The instructions for this new washing machine are only in a language I don't read yet. I've pressed every button twice.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A confirmation for something you've waited years for tends to bring one particular feeling.
quests.explanation: Confirming a purchase you've waited three years for is a clear, simple cause of excitement.
quests.textToSpeak: The pre-order confirmation just arrived. I've been waiting for this game for three years.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Struggling to keep your eyes open at work points to a physical state, not just a mood.
quests.explanation: Barely able to stay awake after a week of broken sleep is a straightforward sign of tiredness.
quests.textToSpeak: The baby has been waking up every two hours all week. I can barely keep my eyes open at my desk today.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Learning a hidden skill about someone you thought you knew well tends to produce a strong reaction.
quests.explanation: Discovering a skill and achievement you had no idea someone had is a clear cause of surprise.
quests.textToSpeak: She said she painted that entire mural herself in one weekend. I honestly didn't know she even liked art.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A promise broken for the third time tends to build a stronger feeling than the first time.
quests.explanation: A promise broken three times in a row is a common, relatable trigger for anger.
quests.textToSpeak: My sister promised to help me move this weekend. She just texted to cancel — for the third time.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Keeping the last written note from someone now in the hospital points to a certain feeling.
quests.explanation: Keeping the last card from someone now unwell, close at hand, reflects real sadness.
quests.textToSpeak: I keep the last birthday card she sent me on my desk. She wrote it just before she went into the hospital.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Avoiding a question because you don't want to hear the answer points to a strong, specific feeling.
quests.explanation: Not wanting to ask what a test might find is a natural sign of being scared.
quests.textToSpeak: The doctor wants to run more tests. I don't want to ask what they're looking for.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Counting down the exact minutes before a performance points to a familiar feeling.
quests.explanation: Counting down the minutes before walking on stage first is a common sign of nervousness.
quests.textToSpeak: My name is first on the audition list. I'll be walking out onto that stage in exactly four minutes.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Reliving a small, familiar routine with someone you love tends to bring a warm feeling.
quests.explanation: Reliving a shared, happy routine and feeling like nothing has changed reflects real happiness.
quests.textToSpeak: We danced in the kitchen while the pasta was cooking, just like we used to. It felt like nothing had changed.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Directions built around something that no longer exists tend to leave you feeling a certain way.
quests.explanation: Following directions based on a landmark that's gone leaves you not knowing which way to turn — that's confusion.
quests.textToSpeak: The directions said turn left at the old bakery. The bakery closed years ago, and now I have no idea which way to go.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A first public display of your own creative work tends to bring one particular feeling.
quests.explanation: Having your own work chosen for a public exhibition is an exciting personal milestone.
quests.textToSpeak: My painting was selected for the city exhibition! It's going to hang in the gallery for six whole weeks!

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Ten years with absolutely no change in the surroundings tends to bring one clear feeling.
quests.explanation: A room that's stayed exactly the same for ten years is a strong, relatable image of boredom.
quests.textToSpeak: The waiting room hasn't changed in ten years — same magazines, same TV channel, same plastic chairs.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Moving to escape a feeling, only to find it followed you, says something about that feeling.
quests.explanation: Realizing that a change of location didn't fix an inner feeling reflects a deeper kind of sadness.
quests.textToSpeak: I thought I'd feel better once I moved to a new city, but the loneliness came with me.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A completely unexpected, high-value find in an ordinary bag tends to bring a strong reaction.
quests.explanation: Finding something of real value where you least expected it is a natural cause of surprise.
quests.textToSpeak: I opened the bag from the charity shop and found a first edition worth over two thousand pounds inside.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: A promise broken, plus an unwelcome surprise cost, tends to build a strong reaction.
quests.explanation: A rent increase with no warning, right after a promise not to raise it, is a common trigger for anger.
quests.textToSpeak: My landlord raised the rent again without any warning, right after promising he wouldn't this year.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Hours of travel starting before dawn, with more still ahead, points to a physical state.
quests.explanation: A pre-dawn start followed by hours more travel is a very ordinary cause of tiredness.
quests.textToSpeak: I've been up since four this morning for the early flight, and we still have three hours left to drive.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and select the matching emotion.
quests.hint: Practicing thoroughly and still feeling unprepared, an hour before something important, is a familiar feeling.
quests.explanation: Feeling unprepared despite real practice, right before a high-stakes interview, is a clear sign of nervousness.
quests.textToSpeak: My immigration interview is in one hour. I've practiced every possible question but still feel unprepared.
